motivation.behind_on_payments.question: Did the seller say they are behind on mortgage payments?

motivation.facing_auction.question: Did the seller say the property has a foreclosure sale or auction date set?

motivation.back_taxes.question: Did the seller say they owe unpaid property taxes on the property?

motivation.bankruptcy.question: Did the seller say they have filed or are filing for bankruptcy?

motivation.liens.question: Did the seller say there is a lien or judgment against the property?

motivation.underwater.question: Did the seller say they owe more on the property than it is worth?

motivation.inherited.question: Did the seller say they inherited the property or are handling it for an estate?

motivation.divorce.question: Did the seller say they are selling because of a divorce or separation?

motivation.downsizing_health.question: Did the seller say the property is a burden and/or has become too much to keep up with?

motivation.tired_landlord.question: Did the seller say they are tired of dealing with tenants or being a landlord?

motivation.vacant.question: Did the seller say no one is living in the property?

motivation.failed_listing.question: Did the seller say the property was listed for sale and did not sell?

motivation.moving_away.question: Did the seller say they have moved or have the desire to move?

motivation.major_repairs.question: Did the seller say the property needs major repairs they cannot or will not do?
